stage.name: Dublinn Burning
stage.description:
Someday, the fire will engulf the one who gazes into the depths of Dublinn.

<Orientation Trial>Use a pre-picked squad of 3 Operators.

dublinn_flamechaser_elite_soldier.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Elite Soldier
dublinn_flamechaser_elite_soldier.flavourText: A elite Dublinn soldier fused with their Leader's ember. Chasing their Leader's ember even more fervently, their bodies are manipulated by Arts to ceaselessly rise from the dead.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Burn while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible <Ember of Fury> that must be damaged 5 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

dublinn_phalanx_infantry.name: Dublinn Phalanx Infantry
dublinn_phalanx_infantry.flavourText: A phalanx infantry in the Dublinn forces. The phalanx tactics they utilize evolved from the combat formations used in Gaul. In the phalanx, nearby infantry will support one another, increasing the might of the formation.
abilities: When other Phalanx Infantry are nearby, DEF increases (stacks)
Refraction

special_forces_captain.name: Special Forces Captain
special_forces_captain.flavourText: An experienced mercenary captain under the long-term employ of a Victorian aristocrat. Often uses the terrain to hide their movements.
abilities: Gains Invisibility while in Reeds

dublinn_flamecaller_captain.name: Dublinn Flamecaller Captain
dublinn_flamecaller_captain.flavourText: An elite caster in the Dublinn forces extremely adept at manipulating flame, ignites everything around them, even their own deaths.
abilities: Attacks ignite Reeds beneath the target
When defeated, deals Arts damage to all nearby friendly units and ignites all Reeds

dublinn_cannoneer_captain.name: Dublinn Cannoneer Captain
dublinn_cannoneer_captain.flavourText: Captain of a ranged squad in the Dublinn forces. They use a modified standard-issue Victorian military crossbow fitted with a launcher for even more powerful explosive ammunition.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack deals Splash damage

dublinn_phalanx_commander.name: Dublinn Phalanx Commander
dublinn_phalanx_commander.flavourText: A phalanx commander in the Dublinn forces, they organize the infantry under their command into phalanx formations. The phalanx tactics they utilize evolved from the combat formations used in Gaul. In the phalanx, nearby infantry will support one another, increasing the might of the formation.
abilities: When other Phalanx Commanders are nearby, DEF increases (stacks)
Refraction

dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender Leader
dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.flavourText: A heavy defender leader in the Dublinn forces, they wield much more sophisticated equipment. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.
abilities: Refraction

dublinn_flamechaser_elite_guard.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Elite Guard
dublinn_flamechaser_elite_guard.flavourText: An elite Dublinn defender fused with their Leader's ember. Chasing their Leader's ember even more fervently, the Arts embedded in their equipment make them hard to defeat.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Burn and takes reduced Physical and Arts damage while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible <Ember of Avarice> that must be damaged 10 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

dublinn_elite_companion_shadowblade.name: Dublinn Elite Companion Shadowblade
dublinn_elite_companion_shadowblade.flavourText: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad, they are much stronger than regular squad members. When they move alongside their partners, they gain powerful stealth capabilities and their attacks are much swifter.
abilities: Invisible
When a <Dublinn Elite Companion Guard> is nearby, significantly increases ASPD

dublinn_companion_guard.name: Dublinn Companion Guard
dublinn_companion_guard.flavourText: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad. The structure of this squad mimics the military system of ancient Minos. The shields they wield are the culmination of many nations' technologies, providing cover for their partners while advancing, and protecting all nearby allies from harm.
abilities: More likely to get attacked by your units
When a <Dublinn Companion Shadowblade> is nearby, activates a field that reduces nearby allied units' ASPD
Refraction

the_brigadier.name: 'The Brigadier'
the_brigadier.flavourText: 'The Brigadier,' a senior Dublinn officer and captain of the Redsteel Guard. With a blade tempered by the flames of war, he cuts through the chaos to find the order he has set his mind on.
abilities: Ignites Reeds upon passing by them
After several attacks, unleashes 5 powerful consecutive slashes at the target

the_leader.name: 'The Leader'
the_leader.flavourText: Dublinn's 'Leader,' the life-burning Draco, the fear-evoking shadow. Do not let her close in on you.
abilities: [Rebirth] While on the field, some enemies will turn into <Embers> upon defeat and continue fighting
First Form

[Sovereign] Casts Exhausted Flame on a target, making them unable to attack or use skills, and dealing Arts damage and Burn to all allied units in a cross shape when Exhausted Flame expires or the target retreats
[Give and Take] Sacrifices up to 5 Flamechaser Soldiers and gains a temporary Physical/Arts Barrier proportional to own max HP based on the number of sacrifices.
Second Form
Gains increased ATK
Immediately ignites all Reeds on the field
Melee attacks deal damage based on doubled ATK
Both ranged attacks and [Sovereign] can choose an additional target

mandragora.name: Mandragora
mandragora.flavourText: One of the leaders of the Dublinn forces, a caster who controls stone. Emerging from the darkness of Victoria, she has sworn to repay the humiliation she suffered at the hands of the nobles manyfold.
abilities: [Stoneshield] Reduces damage taken; temporarily loses effect after being hit by a Tattered Pillar
First Form
[Mandragora's Gaze] Targets the unit with the highest ATK within range, dealing Arts damage and reducing their ASPD. If the target is retreated or defeated, destroy the tile the unit is on
Second Form
[Stoneshield] Grants Low-Altitude Hovering, and continuously deals Arts damage to units within range
Periodically knocks down Tattered Pillars
Uses [Mandragora's Gaze] more frequently
